x: Our new accommodation was praised by many of the visitors and on the whole arrangements went according to plan. The race proved to be a battle between L. Evans of Highgate, walking as an individual, R.

L. Evans of Highgate went into a good lead at the start but eventually fell back and Eric Hall, carrying on from his startling 10's confounded everyone by being first man home in the very good time of 2hrs. 6mins. 47 secs.

Len Evans, now prominent in Belgrave colours, showed that he could be reliable as one of our reserves in the summer season. Bernard Eglington made the long trip down from North Wales for the Belgrave Open '7'.
Dave "I'll never break the hour again" McMullen only had 2 minutes 44 seconds to spare and Len Evans, Martin Bennett and John Dunsford also were under the hour.
The Junior 2 kilos was a Belgrave walkover with Martin Bennett winning from Johnathon Dunsford. Finally we placed 3rd in the 5 kilos with Ray Middleton and Len Evans doing us the honours.

On Boxing Day he teamed up with his brother PETER and sister to enter the Chipstead Pram Race and finished a worthy second behind one JOHN THRESHER. Veteran walker LEN EVANS has been in hospital for an operation and it was good to see him around at Imber Court on the day of the M.P.A.A.

Even Bob Picton has made his reappearance as has Len Evans, in spectator capacity, after an operation. Richard Tanner and Alan Lucas have both been consistant performers over the last few months and it is with regret that Alan has now returned to Australia.
